messages:
emma: Quick sync — planning to run the release train tonight at 18:00 PT. Main items: runtime v2.3, routing policy tweak, and a small feature-flagged UI change. Who's owning the deploy window and smoke checks?

jay: I can own the deploy window (kubectl + canary). ETA 18:00 PT works for me. Will start canary at 18:05.

sasha: I will run smoke tests and watch metrics. Preparing a short checklist now.

liam: I'll be on rollback standby and have the previous infra version ready to re-pin. Signal me if error-rate > 1% or p95 jumps > 300ms.

deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed on main -> release-train (build #842). Artifacts: inference-runtime:v2.3.

emma: Thanks. Quick notes: no DB schema changes in this deploy, feature flag is `ft_ui_plate_v2` — keep it off during canary until smoke green.

jay: Plan: 5% canary for 10m, then 25% for 10m, then 100% if all green. Will tag each step in the deploy log.

sasha: Smoke checklist (short):
```
- curl -sS https://staging.redwood.ai/healthz -> HTTP 200
- quick sample gen: curl -X POST .../v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"health check"}' -> token stream returns
- run small load: 50 rps for 2 minutes from canary runner
- check errors in logs: grep ERROR from runtime pods since deploy start
- sanity embeddings: embed 3 samples and check vector dims
```

liam: Rollback commands ready: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/inference-runtime -n prod --to-revision=REV` and `tf apply -var='image_tag=runtime:v2.2'` in case we need infra pin. I have the exact rev number in Ops notes.

jay: I'll annotate the canary probes: readiness + liveness both 10s, health endpoint, and a custom latency probe hitting /v1/metrics/latency.

emma: Sasha — can you post the thresholds you'll use for auto-abort? I want them in thread so deploy is unambiguous.

sasha: Auto-abort rules I'll watch: error-rate > 1% sustained for 5m, p95 > 500ms for 3m, or increase in 5xx > 0.5% absolute. If trigger -> we halt and rollback.

liam: Also watch cost spike from unexpected batching behavior — if token cost per request > 2x baseline for 10m, abort.

jay: Noted. I'll set the canary durations and manual gates in Spinnaker (canary -> manual judgement -> promote).

emma: CI owners: pinging @jay and @sasha to approve the final release PR and smoke script. Can we close reviews by 17:30 PT?

jay: On it — posting PR link shortly.

sasha: I'm adding the smoke-runner job to run 5 minutes before canary and one check at each promotion.

deploy-bot: Deploy-plan created: release-train/nightly-1769004321. Canary schedule attached.

emma: Final: if anything blocks, drop a message here or call on phone. Otherwise we roll at 18:00 PT and status updates in this thread. :thumbsup:

jay: Will post timestamps for each stage during the window.

sasha: Ready — smoke scripts uploaded to /ops/smoke/release-train-1769.

liam: Standby on pager, will execute rollback if we hit abort conditions.

emma: Thanks team — see you in the window.
